findings.claim: The new GeneratedMessagePackFormatterAttribute is a public, non-Conditional attribute in MessagePack.Annotations. Other attributes consumed only by the generator are marked [Conditional("NEVERDEFINED")] so they are not emitted into user assemblies (L14). This one lacks the marker, so it is now emitted into user assemblies' metadata and adds a public API surface. In addition, `Type? SurrogateType` appears to be a nullable annotation in a file/project whose nullable context is unverified, which could cause a compile warning or error in netstandard2.0 or older-LangVersion builds.

receipt_plan.detail: Compare the attribute declaration with neighbouring generator-only attributes in Attributes.cs for [Conditional("NEVERDEFINED")]. Build MessagePack.Annotations for all target frameworks with warnings-as-errors and check PublicAPI.Unshipped.txt for the new entries.

findings.claim: The new generator-time diagnostics MsgPack019-022 are Error severity and are added to SupportedDiagnostics, but the generator also reports them directly. The reuse of NoDeserializingConstructor, MemberNeedsKey, DoNotMixStringAndIntKeys and KeysMustBeUnique is gated only on the new attribute, so existing users are unaffected. However, the new IDs are not shown in AnalyzerReleases.Unshipped.md in this change, which would trigger RS2000 in the analyzer project, where it is treated as an error, and would break the analyzer build.

receipt_plan.detail: Build MessagePack.SourceGenerator and check for RS2000 (release tracking) errors for MsgPack019-022. Also check that doc/analyzers/MsgPack019.md through MsgPack022.md exist for the help links.

findings.claim: The contractless wire format emitted for annotated formatters is name-sorted, read-write-only, string-keyed. It differs from ContractlessStandardResolver, which uses declaration order and includes get-only members, so existing data serialized by ContractlessStandardResolver will not round-trip. Ledger L20 accepts this, so it is not a defect. The requirement says that attributes on T must be honoured, and L19 says to follow the requirement. In surrogate-less mode, [MessagePackObject]/[Key] on T are ignored.

receipt_plan.detail: Apply [GeneratedMessagePackFormatter] to a formatter for a type with [MessagePackObject] and [Key(1)]/[Key(0)] members, and assert that the generated bytes honour the declared keys. They currently use sorted name string keys.
